# Ștefan Bugalete Architecture & Design

> Ștefan Bugalete is an architect and interior designer with offices in Iași and Bucharest, Romania, working remotely for clients abroad. The studio designs premium homes and medical and dental clinics, from concept to turnkey delivery.

## Facts
- Name: Ștefan Bugalete (also written Stefan Bugalete)
- Profession: architect and interior designer, founder of Ștefan Bugalete Architecture & Design
- Offices: Iași and Bucharest (București), Romania; remote projects abroad
- Portfolio categories: Architecture, Interior, Health
- Services: architecture, interior design, site supervision, turnkey delivery
- Experience: more than eight years of residential interior projects
- Awards: BIG SEE Interior Design Award 2026, Winner, Civic Interiors (Onora Clinic); RAM 2026, Young Vision Award (Velvet Clinic)
- Contact: contact@stefanbugalete.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stefan.bugalete/

## Questions
- What services does Ștefan Bugalete offer? Architecture, interior design, site supervision and turnkey delivery, for premium homes and medical clinics.
- Where do you work? The studio has offices in Iași and Bucharest. I work across Romania and remotely for clients abroad.
- Do you design dental and medical clinics? Yes. Onora Clinic won the BIG SEE Interior Design Award 2026 and Velvet Clinic received the RAM 2026 Young Vision Award.
